issue_request: FHIR-7129 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and reported that Procedure.device was too vague, because it could mean equipment set up or used during surgery rather than devices implanted or otherwise manipulated; its resolution says it was addressed by FHIR-8058.
initial_application: Historical commit 512b2462e3 explicitly listed #7129 and #8058, renamed Procedure.device to Procedure.focalDevice, replaced the vague definition with focal-device wording, and added Procedure.used notes distinguishing incidental devices from devices that are the focus of the procedure.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml defines Procedure.focalDevice as the manipulated, implanted, or removed focal device and directs implanted/removed devices to Procedure.focalDevice.manipulated rather than Procedure.used. The Procedure notes retain the incidental-device versus focal-device distinction. FHIR-8058, FHIR-13976, and FHIR-34525 are already represented on the combined branch and confirm the same current expression of this issue family. No targeted Zulip or Confluence search found a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made; the current build-scope Procedure source already resolves the ambiguity raised by FHIR-7129 through Procedure.focalDevice and Procedure.used guidance.
